'''The Dark Duel of The Fates by John Williams''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[The Dark]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19620">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19620 Duel of The Fates by John Williams], DeckTech (Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith, 6 November 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19620/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19620/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016235717/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19620/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The Dark]]
* '''Published:''' 6 November 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Duel of The Fates by John Williams''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif|label=We'll Handle This}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 WHT Dark LS 2001 19620.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck was created thanks to the Reflections III set, the most controversal set in the SW:CCG thus far.

== Original post ==

'''Duel of The Fates by John Williams'''
* '''Author:''' Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith
* '''Published:''' November 6, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck was created thanks to the Reflections III set, the most controversal set in the SW:CCG thus far.

=== Strategy ===

This deck is based on using RIII cards, though I hate most stuff out of Reflections III, some of it is pretty good, like the broken superpower Fett. Sorry there's no Strategy section, but I have to get off the internet and will try to fill it in tommorow.
